fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell scripts accessing SAM hives
fields.name: PowerShell SAM Copy
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "System32\\config\\sam") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "Copy-Item" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cp $_." or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cpi $_." or tgt.process.cmdline contains "copy $_." or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".File]::Copy(")))
